note: Clinical and fusion results come from different test sets (156 clinical-test patients vs 99 paired multimodal patients), so they are not directly comparable. A shared-split, nested cross-validation comparison is planned (research/README.md).
limitations: Single-centre, retrospective data from one children's hospital; no external validation yet.
"Complicated" is the dataset's severity label (it includes perforation, abscess and similar) and is not a direct perforation test.
The ultrasound branch uses frozen ImageNet features; raw images added little beyond the structured ultrasound report in our experiments.
Uncertainty thresholds are heuristics until conformal calibration on held-out data is completed.
Grad-CAM heatmaps show model attention and are not anatomical or pathological localisation.
